title: fix(app-shell): the agent preview's "Try in chat" link opens the agent's chat route (objectui#10640)
body:
Fixes #10640
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The agent preview's "Try in chat" link (Studio, an agent, the preview's toolbar) now opens that agent's chat page instead of redirecting the author home.

- **`@object-ui/app-shell`, `AgentPreview.tsx`.** The link was the plain anchor `/console/ai/agents/NAME/chat`. The console's root route table declares no path beginning with `/console`, so its `path="*"` catch-all (`RedirectWithSplash` to `/`) took it, and as a plain anchor it also ignored the router basename (`/_console`). The link is now a module-private `AgentChatLink`, the same shape as `ToolPreview`'s `ApiConsoleLink` from PR objectui#10632: one unconditional `useInRouterContext()` call, and react-router's `Link` when a router is present. It points at `/ai/NAME?new=1`:
  - `/ai/:agent` is the chat route the console declares. The segment is `agentRouteName(NAME)` from `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, the existing helper whose docblock says to use it to build `/ai/:agent` links: a custom agent routes by its own name, a built-in by its friendly alias (`metadata_assistant` becomes `build`), which is the form `AiChatPage` canonicalizes to. The segment is `encodeURIComponent`-escaped.
  - `new=1` is the chat page's explicit new-conversation flag, the one its sidebar's New button sends. The link's title has always said "in a new chat"; without the flag the page resumes the thread cached for the chat scope, and custom agents share the `ask` scope.
  - It still opens in a new tab (`target=_blank`, `rel=noreferrer`), as the tool preview's link does. `Link` computes the href through the router, so the basename applies.
  - With no router above the preview (the designer gallery), no link is drawn.
- The component docblock no longer names the dead path; it points at `AgentChatLink`.
- One `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

No route table, no chat page and no other preview is touched.

## Measurements behind the design (the dispatch's items 1 to 5)

1. **The premise holds at base `3d17a9761`.** `App.tsx`'s root table declares `/ai`, `/ai/:agent` and `/ai/:agent/:conversationId`, and no path beginning with `/console`; `StudioRoute.tsx` declares only `/studio`, `:packageId` and `:packageId/:tab`. Reproduced through the REAL `App` before any edit: the new console pin below, run against the unmodified preview, went 2 red and 1 green of 3. The href the real registered preview drew reached the `redirect-with-splash` marker, not the chat page.
2. **What PR objectui#10632 left to reuse.** It inlined its link as two module-private components gated on `useInRouterContext()`, rendered through `Link`, new tab kept. It exported no helper. The one shared builder it reused, `componentRefToUrlSegments`, maps registry keys, and the agent chat has no registry key (`/ai/:agent` is a root route). So this PR follows the same shape and adds no link-building helper; the existing builder for `/ai/:agent` segments is `agentRouteName`, used by `AiChatPage` and `ConversationsSidebar`. The tool preview needed a second component for `useParams`; this one reads no params, so it is one component.
3. **Which route, and whether the app goes with it.** `AiChatPage` resolves `:agent` with `resolveAgentParam(segment, catalogNames)`: an exact catalog name, or a sibling in the built-in alias group. So `:agent` takes the agent's `name`, the friendly alias for a built-in. `/ai/:agent/:conversationId` resumes a specific conversation, and the preview has none. The chat routes are app-less root routes, and no app-scoped chat route exists, so the link carries no app segment. `?package=` binds only the build agent's "Edit with AI" entry, which does not apply here. The preview is rendered by `ResourceEditPage` (`/apps/APP/metadata/agent/NAME`) and the Studio design surface, which call router hooks themselves, so a preview they render always has a router. `EmbeddedItemEditor` also renders previews and calls no router hook; if it ever rendered outside a router, the outcome is no link, not a throw. The designer gallery mounts previews with no router.
4. **Pins and reverse proofs:** below.
5. **Dead-path text.** `git grep -n "console/ai/agents" -- content/docs packages apps` now hits only prose that describes the old link as the old link, plus the control constant in the new console pin. `content/docs` has no hit, and no "Try in chat" text either.

## Pins (real components, no module mock of the link)

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AgentPreview.test.tsx` has a new describe block. It renders the real `AgentPreview` in a `MemoryRouter` under `/apps/:appName/*`, beside `ToolPreview.test.tsx`'s link pins:
- the link's pathname is `/ai/sales_copilot`;
- it carries `new=1`, and its title still says "in a new chat";
- a built-in agent routes by the segment `agentRouteName` builds (`metadata_assistant` to `/ai/build`);
- it carries no app segment, from `com.acme.crm` as from `studio`;
- it is drawn on a route that names no app (a Studio design-surface URL);
- an agent name that needs escaping (`odd name/x?y#z`) stays one path segment, with no hash split off;
- under `basename="/_console"` the href is `/_console/ai/sales_copilot`;
- it still has `target=_blank` and `rel=noreferrer`;
- control: no link, and no throw, with no router above it.

`apps/console/src/__tests__/App.agentChatLink-10640.test.tsx` is new. It renders the console's REAL `App`, so its root route table, the way `internalFormShell.test.tsx` does, with that file's stub list for everything `App.tsx` imports but this card does not touch. The catch-all element and `DefaultAiChatPage` are stubbed to markers; the chat stub reports the `:agent` and `:conversationId` params and the `new` flag it was routed with. The href is the one the REAL registered agent preview (`getMetadataPreview('agent')`) draws under `/apps/:appName/*`:
- it reaches the chat page as `/ai/:agent`, with `agent` equal to `sales_copilot`, no conversation id and `new=1`, and not the catch-all;
- an agent name that needs escaping arrives as the `:agent` param exactly, and its slash does not spill into `:conversationId`;
- control: the pre-fix URL `/console/ai/agents/sales_copilot/chat` reaches only the catch-all.

## Reverse proofs

Both legs ran from committed state (`be5b3d184`) through `../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, under a shell `trap` that also restores from `HEAD`. Each anchor hit once (1 to 0). Each restore was proven by blob equal to HEAD (`7e9e650`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The test modules import `@object-ui/app-shell` through the vitest alias to `src`, so no rebuild sits between the mutation and the run. The base-commit reproduction in item 1 went red, and the fix went green, with no build in between.

1. **The old href restored** inside the `to` expression (`/console/ai/agents/NAME/chat`). Predicted 9 of 19 red before the run; observed **9 failed, 10 passed**. Red: the seven href pins in app-shell and the two console route-table pins. Green: the new-tab pin, the no-router control, the pre-fix-URL control and the seven existing AgentPreview pins.
2. **`encodeURIComponent` dropped.** **2 failed, 17 passed**: exactly the two escaping pins. The app-shell pin read `/ai/odd%20name/x`, and the console pin's chat page received `agent` equal to `odd name`.

## Local verification (at head `be5b3d184`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/` plus the console suites that render the real `App` (`App.agentChatLink-10640`, `App.docsPortalLazy`, `App.uploadAltitude-10131`, `internalFormShell`), `components/StudioRoute.test.tsx` and the three `preview-samples-*` suites: **69 files, 781 tests passed**.
- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`: 28 of 28 tasks successful. Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `--listFiles` shows `AgentPreview.test.tsx` in the `tsconfig.test.json` program.
- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2`: 34 of 34 tasks successful, including app-shell's `tsc` build and its dist-completeness check. Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0. `--listFiles` shows the new console test in the program.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build`, then `pnpm check:eager-closure`: 3051.3 KB of the 3104.5 KB budget across 329 chunks, with every per-chunk ceiling green. `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, which the preview now imports, was already statically imported on the package entry's path (`useAiSurface`), so this adds no new module to it; its chunk is in the eager list at head. No base-commit build was compared.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims` (no pending changeset names a touched file), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:i18n-keys`.
- ESLint on the 3 touched source files, one run: 0 errors and 4 warnings. All four are `no-explicit-any` on lines this diff does not touch (the memory rail's three casts and `getPath`). This is a narrowed run, and three facts back it:
  - the flat config applies to all three files (all three are in the results);
  - the file count, 3, is read from `--format json`;
  - no type-aware linting is configured (no `parserOptions`, `project` or `projectService` in `eslint.config.js`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- **NOT MEASURED: the full `@object-ui/app-shell` package test**, reason: it does not fit the foreground cap. Declared to CI's sharded `pnpm test`.
- Not probed in a running app.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** The claim named the preview, "pins beside the existing preview tests", and one changeset. The route-table pin needs the console's root table, which `App.tsx` does not export; only a console test can render it, as `internalFormShell.test.tsx` and PR objectui#10632's console pin do. So this PR adds one test file under `apps/console/src/__tests__/`. It changes no console source.
- On a runtime that serves no AI (Community Edition), the chat routes' own `RequireAiSurface` guard redirects to home. The preview still draws the link, as it did before.
- A name the live agent catalog does not serve (an unsaved draft, or an agent the runtime does not list) is read by `AiChatPage` as a legacy bare conversation id. The page then lands on the default agent's surface. That is the chat page's documented back-compat rule, and this PR does not change it.
- Each click mints a new conversation row, as the chat sidebar's New button does.
- The designer gallery's agent card no longer shows the link, because the gallery mounts with no router.

None filed.
